image50: An employer celebrates record profits and a people-first slogan while employees look disappointed at their pay.
Shows a mirror revealing the workers behind the employer and a message about payroll.
The employer commits to higher base pay and shared profits.
Let your values reach the payroll.
Translate stated values into material benefit for the workers
image52: A different use for a branch
A man considers removing a large tree branch.
Suggests another purpose and helps hang a swing from the branch.
The man enjoys the swing while a bird rests on the preserved branch.
A different purpose changes the picture.
Find another use before removing something
image53: An imperfect vessel leaves a trail
A gardener is discouraged by a leaking watering can.
Points out the flower-lined path created by its drips.
She enjoys flowers and a butterfly along the route.
Look what happened along the way.
Recognize an unexpected benefit of an apparent flaw
image54: A café worker examines a worn entrance step beside replacement material.
Shows an old photograph of generations entering through that doorway.
The worker welcomes an older visitor across the same step.
Years of welcome leave a mark.
Recognize wear as evidence of lives and welcome
image55: Goodie holds a café door open while a woman is trying to paint it.
Notices her gesture and changes approach.
Goodie helps paint the closed door alongside the woman.
Notice what help is needed rather than impose an assumed solution
image56: Goodie readies the heart button as a woman drops an orange.
Pauses without activating the button as a passerby picks up the orange.
The woman thanks the helper; ordinary people are already helping nearby.
Notice kindness without needing a magical intervention
image57: Two neighbors compete through absurdly oversized gift baskets.
Presents a small plain box marked with a sun, prompting reconsideration.
They carry the small box together while the extravagant gifts remain behind.
Cooperate on a modest gift instead of competing through excess
image58: An older worker packs his desk on retirement day, wondering about his impact.
Brings a plant as colleagues arrive carrying plants of their own.
The colleagues gather with plants and a thank-you note, showing growth he helped nurture.
You don’t always see what you’ve helped grow.
Recognize lasting influence through the growth and people it supported
